Satellite Saditsat (SKI SATISH DHAWAN SAT, SDSAT. SD Sat, SD'Sat)
Spacecraft type CubeSat
Units or mass 3U
Status Reentry 2023-07-18. Was operational until 2021-04-03 (Official Twitter as of 2021-03-27 and radio amateur reports. Last TinyGS packet on 2021-04-03, which broadly matches SatNOGS packets with proper data. Last checked 2024-12-18)
Launched 2021-02-28
NORAD ID 47721
Deployer ?
Launcher PSLV (C51)
Entity name Space Kidz India
Institution Non-profit
Entity Academic / Education
Nation India
Oneliner

Educational mission studying space radiation, magnetosphere and demonstrating nanosatellite components.
Description

Goals of the Satellite

  • To study space radiation
  • Magnetosphere and
  • Demonstrate the indigenously designed and developed nanosatellite components as part of our Hon'ble PM's Vision - Aatmanirbhar Bharat Initiative.

The satellite also tests the capabilities of LoRa technology in Space which could be helpful for many applications in the future in short and M2M communication.
